fusions.name: Seizing Lunge
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 5 tiles to a target and seizes it with a strike that deals 12 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Open Palm
fusions.desc: Slaps a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thumbs on Every Limb
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Clasp
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 8%. Your armour also rises by 6%.
